title: FixProposal
description: The structured output the fix proposer must return. Enforced via output_config.format so the response is validated rather than parsed out of prose.

diff.description: A unified diff against the target revision, applicable with a standard patch tool from a clean checkout. May touch any path, including tests.

rationale.description: Why this change is expected to make the failing tests pass. Preserved in the run record so a human can tell a genuine fix from a weakened test.

files_touched.description: Repository-relative paths the diff modifies. Redundant with the diff on purpose: a mismatch is a cheap signal that the diff is malformed.
